12. (a)   Consider the following recursive function:
recfn(N)
    if N <= 0
        then
            return 0
        else
            if N mod 2 = 0
                then
                    return recfn(N-1) - N
                else
                    return recfn(N-1) + N
            endif
    endif
end recfn
Determine the value of variable X after execution of the following program statement:
X = recfn(5)
Show all your working. [5]

assessed_concepts: Original source task: Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of using one central computer to manage the city’s traffic light system.
Discuss replacing independent junction controllers with one networked central traffic controller

markscheme.marking_summary: A central system can coordinate signals to reduce queues across several junctions and simplify updates. However, the central computer or its communication links become critical failure points; loss of communication may disrupt many junctions. Local fallback control can reduce the risk while retaining coordination benefits.
